entries.title: Psalms 107:1
segments: O give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good; for His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 107:2
segments: Let the redeemed of the LORD say [so], whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,

entries.title: Psalms 107:3
segments: and gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

entries.title: Psalms 107:4
segments: They wandered in the wilderness, in a desert by the way; they found no city to dwell in.

entries.title: Psalms 107:5
segments: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

entries.title: Psalms 107:6
segments: Then they cried to the LORD in their distress, and He delivered them out of their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 107:7
segments: And He guided them by the right way, so as to go to a city to live in.

entries.title: Psalms 107:8
segments: Oh that men would praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

entries.title: Psalms 107:9
segments: For He satisfies the thirsty soul, and fills the hungry soul [with] good.

entries.title: Psalms 107:10
segments: Those who sit in the darkness and in the shadow of death, [being] chained in affliction and iron;

entries.title: Psalms 107:11
segments: because they rebelled against the words of God, and despised the advice of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 107:12
segments: and He humbled their heart with labor; they fell down, and none [was] helping.

entries.title: Psalms 107:13
segments: Then they cried to the LORD in their distress, [and] He saved them out of their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 107:14
segments: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands in two.

entries.title: Psalms 107:15
segments: Let them praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

entries.title: Psalms 107:16
segments: For He has broken the gates of bronze, and cut the bars of iron in two.

entries.title: Psalms 107:17
segments: Fools are afflicted because of their rebellion, and because of their iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 107:18
segments: Their soul hates all kinds of food; and they draw near the gates of death.

entries.title: Psalms 107:19
segments: Then they cry to the LORD in their distress, [and] He saves them out of their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 107:20
segments: He sent His word and heals them, and delivers [them] from their pitfalls.

entries.title: Psalms 107:21
segments: Let them praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and [for] His wonderful works to the sons of man!

entries.title: Psalms 107:22
segments: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare His works with rejoicing!

entries.title: Psalms 107:23
segments: They who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;

entries.title: Psalms 107:24
segments: these see the works of the LORD and His wonders in the deep.

entries.title: Psalms 107:25
segments: For He commands and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

entries.title: Psalms 107:26
segments: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again [to] the depths; their soul is melted because of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 107:27
segments: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and all their wisdom is swallowed up.

entries.title: Psalms 107:28
segments: And they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and He brings them out of their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 107:29
segments: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

entries.title: Psalms 107:30
segments: And they are glad because they are quiet; so He brings them to their desired haven.

entries.title: Psalms 107:31
segments: Let them praise the LORD [for] His goodness, and for His wonderful works to the sons of man!

entries.title: Psalms 107:32
segments: And let them exalt Him in the congregation of the people, and praise Him in the gathering of the elders.

entries.title: Psalms 107:33
segments: He sets rivers to a wilderness and water-springs to thirsty ground;

entries.title: Psalms 107:34
segments: a fruitful land to a salty desert, because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

entries.title: Psalms 107:35
segments: He turns the wilderness into a water-ponds, and dry ground into water-springs.

entries.title: Psalms 107:36
segments: And He makes the hungry dwell there, so that they may prepare a city to live in;

entries.title: Psalms 107:37
segments: and sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

entries.title: Psalms 107:38
segments: He also blesses them, so that they are multiplied greatly; and does not allow their cattle to become few.

entries.title: Psalms 107:39
segments: Again, they have become few, and humbled through harshness, affliction, and sorrow.

entries.title: Psalms 107:40
segments: He pours scorn on nobles, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, [where there is] no path.

entries.title: Psalms 107:41
segments: But He raises up the poor from affliction and sets families like a flock.

entries.title: Psalms 107:42
segments: The upright shall see and rejoice; and all iniquity shall stop its mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 107:43
segments: Whoever [is] wise, and will observe these [things], they shall understand the mercies of the LORD.
